1.1: Angmok meumok tha, Geumeu mic mok nang meux chiuxoh.
1.2: Meux na angphi meqe' dagac' yiuli, chiun chiuncdeu neu na, reunyeung athang thak kax siumak ngoli, Geumeu pheulax na, changaf thak ka shiudem se.
1.3: Geumeu mic gac neu la ne neuk, wali gen notha, gac neu anec ani.
1.4: Gac neu na, siula ohneu Geumeu mic rax batha, angmic gac neu nang chiun deu neu avec aba.
1.5: Gac neuka, Geumeu mic ayac' lenc noli, chiuncdeu neu kana ashiuc lenc no.
1.6: Geumeu mic changaf ka, dihang demc mok shiulim la ane neuk, wali gen notha, ohyoc aphoq je.
1.7: Ohtha angmic changaf kana, mok shiulim thak nang euphang avec aba.
1.8: Geumeu mic mok shiulim kana mok lenc aba. Ohthana ashiuc bi jeli gac ani tha anyiu nyiu wa nyiu ye.
1.9: Geumeu mic asa song' ane neuk yoca mok shiulim phang changaf ka, thasic la diheum beu, wali gen notha ohyoc aphoq je.
1.10: Ohtha Geumeu mic asa song' kana sademc lenc noli, thasic diheum je changaf ka salangwa meux lenc no. Yaneu na siula e, wali Geumeu mic rax aba.
1.11: Ohneu rang Geumeu mic asademc ka, shiun angchiu chiux nang angyeux aneoh ken angchiu chiux, angshiuc ziuoh sheungzeungc longc zeungc layoq je.
1.12: Asademc kana, shiun angchiu chiux, ken angchiu chiux angshiuc ziuoh siuzeungc longc zeung angchiu chiux yoq ani.
1.13: Yadang chiux na siula e, wali Geumeu mic rax aba. Ohtha ashiuc bi jeli gac anitha asium nyiu wanyiu ye.
1.14-15: Geumeu mic ayac' ashiuc nang angnyiu angyak, angnyeung nang siulac nang ang siuthax ka ave' demc, mokthak kamic sademc ka tse demc, ga demc latse neuk, wali gen notha ohyoc aphoq je.
1.16: Geumeu mic tse demc deungx anyiu neu chiux ohli, theroh neuna ayac' tha, chemx mo neu na ashiuc tha zium dijiucoh. Oh neu rang kunyiq geu chiuxoh.
1.17-18: Sademc ka gac neu tse dijiuc ohli, ayac' ashiuc ka zium dijiu demc laki, chiundeu neu nang gac neuka ave' demc Geumeu mic tse demc yadang neu mok shiulim ka ane dijiucoh. Ohdang neu na siula e, wali Geumeu mic rax aba.
1.19: Ohtha ashiuc bi jeli gac ani tha abiu nyiu wanyiu ye.
1.20: Geumeu mic changaf deungka deungcoh chiuc hadang labeungx beu. Mok shiulim kageu, cha ang chiu chiu la demx, wali gen no.
1.21: Changaf dungka deungcoh chiuc deungx neu nang akiwa deungc oh angchiuc chiuc nang mok shiulim ka cha ang chiu chiux ka geu chiux oh. Yadang chiu na siula e, wali Geumeu mic rax aba.
1.22: Ohtha Geumeu mic yadang neuka riuguc pholi, changaf dungka deungcoh angchiuc chiuc nang mok shiulim ka cha angchiuc chiuc hadang geu, angchiuc na angchiuc ajenx li ajix' neuk tha, salangwa dung nang asademc thak ka labeungx beu, gen no.
1.23: Ohtha ashiuc bi jeli gac ani tha phongwa nyiu wanyiu ye.
1.24: Geumeu mic sademc thak ka, angchiuc angjenx neu nyiunax, adamx sha nang beuleung beulang nang agusocoh deungcoh angchiuc la ane neuk, wali gen notha ohyoc aphoq je.
1.25: Yadang chiu hadang na, Geumeu mic chiuxoh neu yiuli siula e, wali ang mic rax aba.
1.26: Geumeu mic nga' angchiuc chiuc nang cha angchiuc chiuc, asa thak ka agu socoh meuc beuleung beunglang nang sademc ka zium suc wademc lak nif ka aloet li atsang chiuxi, ve.
1.27-28: Ohtha Geumeu mic angba' yoca atsang chiuxoh. Angmic lalarac nang chamarac chiux ohli, angneung ka riuguc pholi, chamrac dikeum moli, phachiu aji' kamic sademc ka sheung labeung. Asademc yaneu nang changf dungka nga', mokshiulim ka cha angchiu chiux, asademc ka deungcoh angchiuc chiuc hadang thak ka la ziummo.
1.29: Ayox mic naneung phalac emdemc angchiu chiux nang sheungc shiuc longc shiuc digeu beufsa.
1.30: Asademc ka nyiunax, adamx sha nang beuleung beulang, mok shiulim ka cha angchiu chiux hadang phalac geu beusheungxoh shiun angchiu chiux digeu beufsa, ve. Ohtha ohyoc aphoq je.
1.31: Geumeu angmic chiux aba neu hadang ka jangcoh tha, phachiu siula e, wali rax aba laki angna phachiu nase. Ohtha ashiuc bi jeli gac anitha akok nyiu wanyiu ye.

2.1: Ohyoc Geumeu mic mok, asademc nang aneoh yiudang thi chiux dangc aba.
2.2: Geumeu na ang lamac hadang wadangc abali, siungit nyiu wanyiu ka deungac e.
2.3: Siungit nyiu wanyiu na, Geumeu mic chiuxoh lamac hadang wa dangc abali, deungac oh angnyiu yiulak, angmic ohnyiu neukka, heung shangc ngo angnyiu ye, wali asex' aba.
2.4: Yaneu na, Geumeu mic mok, asa chiux aba neu meusiunc ye.
2.5: Yehowa Geumeu mic mok asademc chiux abatha, angmic tsiu chiu madizak ngoli, asademc ka sheung zeungc longc zeungc chiu meuyoq. Kenshiu kenbinx geu chiu meuyoq. Lamac wasu geu meu rung.
2.6: Yiuli geu asademc dung aneoh changaf sak aha' dijiuc ohli asa song ka jap dijiucoh.
2.7: Yehowa Geumeu na asamic atsang moxohli, ang siunac kamic ahux ohtha, deungcoh chiuc yiu je.
2.8: Ohtha, Yehowa Geumeu mic Edin, nemtse kaq jahamc thihangc waohli, angmic chiux aba atsang ka rung dijiucoh.
2.9: Yehowa Geumeu mic jang anep li, em siulaoh angshiuc ziuoh neu sheungzeungc angchiu chiux geu asa kamic yoq dijiuc oh. Jahamc dieux kana, sakbeungc sheungzeungc thizeung nang siula ohneu nang chaq ohneu ka aneq sodemc phaqziu sheung zeungc thi zeungc yoq dijiucoh.
2.10: Edin ka chiumeux thiqax' ayeuc anili, jahamc ka jap dijiuc oh. Chiumeu oh wax' Edin jahamc kamic ayeu lic abatha, abiudox' dibaeq jeli chiumeux abiudox' phoq je.
2.11: Angmok thidox' beungx na, Phishon yiuli Havila meux ka meuk wangxoh.
2.12: Ohka aneoh shiu na siula athang neu ye, pheulongc nang pheulem naq oh Mora zeungc geu ane.
2.13: Anyiu dox' thidox' beungx na, Gihon yiuli, Koshiu meux ka meuk wangoh.
2.14: Asium dox' thidox' beungx na, Thagaris yiuli Asiriva meux nemtse kaq ayeu e. Abiu dox' na Yufaritis ye.
2.15: Jahamc ka cheu suc Yehowa Geumeu mic atsang yoq ka, Edin jahamc dung rung dijiucoh.
2.16: Yehowa Geumeu mic angka siulap kha jiucohli, jahamc dung sheunc shiuc longc shiuc nax nina shiu yoca emdaeqe.
2.17: Ohyoc yiugeu siula ohneu nang chaq ohneu ka aneq sodemc phaqziu sheungzeungc kamic angshiuc na, nax em meudaeq. Ni em beu nyiu na kadic geu nishiux neuk, wali gen no.
2.18: Yehowa Geumeu mic atsang ang thiyoq adiq rung na, masiula. Ayox mic angka diguc suc dachiurac thiyoq digeux' oh, ve.
2.19: Yehowa Geumeu mic asa luxohli, nyiunax adamx sha hadang nang mok shiulim cha angchiuc chiuc hadang ka chiux ohli, angmic Adam jeka shiunx naya li beungx len dijucoh. Adam mic kachiu ka kadic geu ngo na ohyoc ang beungx yiu je.
2.20: Adam mic nyiuna, adamx sha nang cha meuc ka angbeung lenc naba geu, ang phalac diguc suc wa anep mo neu thichiux geu mabac.
2.21: Ohyoc yiuli, Yehowa Geumeu mic Adam ka nyiup yeu dijiuc ohli, ang demxcshiq thichiq lux aba thana, ohphux ka sha dibeun dijiuc aba.
2.22: Yehowa mic demxcshiq ohneu mic chamarac thiyoq riumeun noli, Adam ka shiun ayaf.
2.23: Ohtha Adam mic yaneu na ayox thichiuc neu ayox shareu nang ayox sha mic riumeun saq yiuli, ang na lalarac kamic phoq ani lak, ang kana chamarac len phongxoh, ve.
2.24: Ohlaki lalarac na, angpheux ang meux kamic dikak shiuli, ang chama nang rung beuli thisha thi riugeu adiq aphoq jiu neu ye.
2.25: Adam nang ang chama na, dagwac chaec rungli geu shiurak demc meuqe.

3.1: Yehowa Geumeu mic chiux aba, adamx sha chiuc hadang kamic digoq athang neuna, beux ye. Beux mic chamarac ka jahamc dung ka zeungc mazeungc kamic angshiuc meuc naneung em meudaeq, wali Geumeu wa ohneu na, angcheungc ye me? wali riut no.
3.2: Ohtha, chamarac mic beux ka jahamc dungka sheungc shiuc meuc ayeung emdaeq meuc boem me.
3.3: Ohyoc yiugeu Geumeu mic ayeung ka, naneung meushiu demc lak jahamc dideux ka yoqoh zeungc angshiuc em meudaeq, siup geu siup meudaeq ni gen ni, gen no.
3.4: Beux mic chamarac ka ohneu na acheuk ve. Naneung angcheungc na meushiuq-iu yak.
3.5: Sheungc shiuc ohneu nanyiu niemc beushiu tha, nyiq nigi' nishiu li Geumeu yoca aphoq yak li, siula ohneu nang chaq ohneu ka ave' soc ano neuk Geumeu socoh lak, waoh neu ye, gen no.
3.6: Ohtha, chamarac na, sheungzeungc ohneu phachiu anepli, emnaqa neu rax abana, so phaqziu geu ane neuk neu soc abalak, angmic emc moli, ang lalax ka geu jiuc ohli em je.
3.7: Sheungshiuc ohneu angnyiu em je chax' angnyiu na nyiq gi' jeli dagwac chaec yiuoh neu soc abatha shiurak jeli, angnyiu na meuneu shep mic diga phok phaqe.
3.8: Ohnyiu ashiuc phang tha jahamc ka, Geumeu jiux ayiu sak angnyiu thoca batha, Adam nang angchama na, Yehowa Geumeu je kamic sheungc phang dung yet ma je.
3.9: Yehowa Geumeu mic Adam ka nax kakax nirunge me? wali geuk ngo.
3.10: Adam mic, jahamc ka nax nijiu ayiu sak thongc ohli, ayox dagwac chaec yeungc abeunga lak pheurer li masheungce, wali thangxo.
3.11: Ohtha Geumeu mic nax dagwac chaec niyiu neu kayoq mic naxka nigen ne me? Ayox mic naka tha em wa saq sheungc shiuc neu nax niem je me? gen no.
3.12: Adam mic, naxmic ayox ka nijiuci yoq chamarac mic sheungzeungc ohneu angshiuc ayox ka nijeungc li emc abeunga, ve.
3.13: Ohtha Yehowa Geumeu mic chamarac ka, nax kachiu lak ohyoc niwax oh me? gen notha, chamarac na beux mic ni nyium li, emc abeunga, wali athangx ngo.
3.14: Ohhtha Yehowa Geumeu mic beux ka nax yayoc niwax abalak, naxna nyiunax, adamx sha hadang thak kamic meutseuk saq niyiu je. Nax ditseuk na pha kamic na siulo' shiuli, asa em shonge.
3.15: Ayox mic nax nang chamarac ka heu adijiu demc ye. Nax pheulic pheulaq geu adiheu neuk. Ang pheulic pheulaq mic nax laphongc ka thoc daeq nadijiuli naxmic geu ang herczeu ka najet ano, gen no.
3.16: Geumeu mic chamarac ka, nax chamarac dangc beutha disha demc neu nang dikeum azademc neu ayox mic boem dijiu demc ye. Naxna phachiu aza nicheungx shiuli cham rac na dikeumx moli geu, naxna nax lalax ka nyireum nnithim shiuli angna, naxka nizeux yake, gen no.
3.17: Adam kageu Geumeu mic naxna nax chama kha nithoq ohli, ayox mic tha em, wang neu sheung shiuc niem jelak, nax laki asademc na meutseuk saq yiu je. Nax na thic ditseuk man nahok li asa kamic em nithap ano.
3.18: Asademc ka na nax phalac phaheuc nang shiun yoq neukli, naxna kentsiu kenyongx nang meux ka sheungc chiu angchiu chiux em demc yiu neuk.
3.19: Nax thic ditseuk yiut nayeu kamic em nithap ano. Naxka na asamic moxsaq yiulak nax nishiux beu geu asaka athang demc yiu beu e, gen no.
3.20: Adam chama na, asademc atsang hadang kop meux yiuli, Adam mic angka Ewa lenc no.
3.21: Yehowa Geumeu mic Adam nang Ewa phalac shasamx gameux wapholi dikwacoh.
3.22: Yehowa Geumeu mic atsang na, nif yoca siula ohneu nang chaq ohneu ka soc abalak sakbeungc sheungzeungc angshiuc neu geu em thap abo thana, angna katha geu meushiux rung neuke. Ohyoc na yiu dijiu meudaeq, ve.
3.23: Ohlaki, Yehowa Geumeu mic atsang ka Edin jahamc kamic kwae abali, angka mox ayax asa ka lamac wali em dijiucoh.
3.24: Ohneu rang Yehowa Geumeu mic jahamc dungka atsang meuzang demc nang sakbeungc sheungzeungc ka mathaok ano yoca, jahamc nemtse cha' ka Cherubim cheu dijiuc ohli, akiwa lap kaq geu chemi meuclemx shemx hwaq shiu dijiucoh.
